node.title: XR SL-2 high-window exclusion: selected band occupancy N_d <= 17n^2/25 at every prize-row high band-proper depth
node.statement: At each of the three prize rows, for every globally generic-branch received pair after the ratified strip order and every ceil(h/2)<=d<=h-2, the support-wise first-match selected occupancy N_d of depth-d joint-explanation pairs carrying at least two selected live slopes satisfies 25N_d<=17n^2. Together with the banked low-depth envelope and cascade cap this fits the row-exact H_band=s_lo-16n^3 budget. The constant is not a claim about the stronger row-specific single-word window thresholds. The RowC rows are outside this node because their occupancy budget is vacuous. The canonical MC/coset construction is already excluded from this depth window by xr_mc_depth_quantization, so any falsifier requires a non-coset or finite-characteristic-accidental mechanism; this is not claimed as a complete classification. The windowed-list inequality in xr_band_windowed_projection_reduction is a sufficient attack route, not part of this assertion.
